Line segments of a dendrogram

Source: R/plotDendrogram.R
dendrogramSegments.Rd

Line segments of a dendrogram

Usage

dendrogramSegments(hc, leafHeight = 0)

Arguments

hc

An hclust object.

leafHeight

Height at which the leaves are drawn.

Value

A data.frame with columns x, y, xend and yend; leaves are at x = 1, 2, ... in the order of hc$order and at leafHeight.
